name: Plasma
desc: The demoscene classic: three waves, every colour
src:
loop 8
-- three waves added together
wave = sin(x*2 + t/8) + sin(y*1.5 - t/4) + sin(x*1.5 + y + t/8)
hsv(wave/6 + t/8, 0.9, 1)

name: Fire
desc: Flames licking up from the bottom
src:
loop 4
-- curl bends the flames, more and more as they rise
curl = sin(y*1.5 - t)*0.25 + sin(y*3 - t*2 + x*4)*0.15
flames = sin(x*6 + curl)*0.5 + sin(x*11 - curl)*0.5
heat = (1 - y)*(1.6 + flames*0.7) - 0.5
pal(fire, clamp(heat, 0, 0.95))

name: Rain
desc: Blue streaks falling at different speeds
src:
loop 4
-- a made-up random number for each column: about half the columns get a drop
r = frac(sin(px*0.37)*97.3)
drop = frac(y + t*(floor(r*6) + 1)/2 + r*2)
glow = max(0, 1 - drop*5) * step(r, 0.5)
rgb(glow*0.5, glow*0.7, glow)

name: Matrix
desc: Green code raining down the screen
src:
loop 8
-- 32 columns of little 3x5 characters, each column falling at its own speed
r = frac(floor(px/4)*0.618)
fall = frac(y*0.5 + t*(floor(r*3) + 1)/4 + r)
glyph = step(0.35, frac(px*(py*0.3719 + 0.13))) * step(px%4, 2.5) * step(py%6, 4.5)
head = step(fall, 0.04) * glyph
rgb(head, glyph*(1 - fall*1.8) + head, head)

name: Lava lamp
desc: Slow glowing blobs drifting up and down

name: Rings
desc: Colourful rings rippling out from the middle
src:
loop 4
-- distance from the middle (x counts 4 times: the panel is 4 times wider)
d = len((x - 0.5)*4, y - 0.5)
pal(rainbow, frac(d*1.5 - t/2))

name: Moiré
desc: Two sets of ripples crossing into shimmering patterns
src:
loop 8
-- two ripple centres drifting around (x counts 4 times: the panel is 4 times wider)
dx1 = (x - 0.3 - 0.1*sin(t/8))*4; dy1 = y - 0.5
dx2 = (x - 0.7 + 0.1*sin(t/8))*4; dy2 = y - 0.5 - 0.3*cos(t/8)
ripples = sin((dx1*dx1 + dy1*dy1)*1.2) + sin((dx2*dx2 + dy2*dy2)*1.2)
pal(ice, ripples*0.25 + 0.5)

name: XOR pattern
desc: The old-school bit-twiddling texture, sliding along
src:
loop 8
-- sqr flips between 1 and -1: multiplying two of them works like the computer's XOR
u = px + t*8 + 0.5
v = py + t*4 + 0.5
same = sqr(u/4)*(sqr(v/4)*0.07) + sqr(u/8)*(sqr(v/8)*0.13) + sqr(u/16)*(sqr(v/16)*0.27) + sqr(u/32)*(sqr(v/32)*0.53)
pal(rainbow, 0.55 - same*0.45)

name: Stripes
src:
loop 4
-- a: stripe width
size = 8 + a*24
band = sin((px + py)/size - t/2)
s = clamp(band*1.5 + 0.5, 0, 1)
rgb(1, s, s)

name: Starfield
desc: Stars streaking past at three speeds
src:
loop 8
-- each row gets a made-up random number: no star, or a slow, medium or fast one
r = frac(sin(py*0.123)*71.3)
speed = floor(r*4)
p = frac(x*2 + t*speed/4 + r*5)
gray(max(0, 1 - p*(14 - speed*3)) * speed/3)

name: Clock
desc: A clock face with hour and minute hands
src:
-- Hands on a round dial; dx, dy: pixels from the middle
dx = px - 63.5; dy = py - 15.5
frame { hours = (hour%12 + minute/60)/12; mins = minute/60 }
hour_hand = step(max(abs(dx*cos(hours) - dy*sin(hours)), abs(dx*sin(hours) + dy*cos(hours) - 4) - 3), 1)
minute_hand = step(max(abs(dx*cos(mins) - dy*sin(mins)), abs(dx*sin(mins) + dy*cos(mins) - 6.5) - 5.5), 0.8)
dial = step(abs(dx*dx + dy*dy - 218), 22)
pal(ice, dial*0.6 + hour_hand + minute_hand)

name: Sunrise
desc: The sky changes colour with the time of day
src:
-- a: time of day (all the way left: follow the clock)
frame { day = a > 0 ? a : (hour + minute/60)/24; sun = -cos(day) }
light = clamp(sun*1.5 + 0.3, 0, 1)
warm = clamp(1 - abs(sun)*3, 0, 1) * (1 - y)
sx = (day*2 - 0.5 - x)*4; sy = sun*0.8 - y
disc = step(sx*sx + sy*sy, 0.04)
rgb(0.02 + light*(0.6 - 0.4*y) + warm*0.9 + disc, 0.02 + light*(0.8 - 0.35*y) + warm*0.35 + disc*0.9, 0.1 + light*(0.9 - 0.1*y) + disc*0.6)

name: CRT
desc: TV colour bars with scanlines and a rolling band
src:
loop 4
bar = floor(x*7)
lines = 0.4 + 0.6*(py%2)
roll = 0.7 + 0.4*max(0, tri(y/2 + t/4))
glow = lines*roll*(1 - (x - 0.5)*(x - 0.5)*1.5 - (y - 0.5)*(y - 0.5)*1.2)
rgb(step(bar%4, 1.5)*glow, step(bar, 3.5)*glow, step(bar%2, 0.5)*glow)

name: Rainbow wave
desc: A retro rainbow ribbon waving across the screen
src:
loop 8
band = (y - 0.5 - 0.25*sin(x*1.5 - t/4))*1.8 + 0.5
inside = step(0, band)*step(band, 1)
hsv((5 - floor(band*6))/7, 1, inside)

name: Spotlight
desc: A spotlight sweeping across a brick wall
src:
loop 8
-- a: spotlight size
row = floor(py/8)
brick = step(1, py%8) * step(1, (px + row%2*8)%16)
dx = (x - 0.5 - 0.38*sin(t/8))*4; dy = y - 0.5 - 0.3*sin(t/4)
light = clamp(1.3 - (dx*dx + dy*dy)/(0.05 + a*0.5), 0.15, 1)
rgb(light*(0.4 + 0.5*brick), light*(0.4 - 0.15*brick), light*(0.4 - 0.25*brick))

name: Copper bars
desc: Shiny Amiga-style bars bouncing up and down
src:
loop 4
-- each bar is brightest in its middle, in steps like the old chips
red = floor(max(0, 1 - abs(y - 0.5 - 0.35*sin(t/4))*5)*6)/6
gold = floor(max(0, 1 - abs(y - 0.5 - 0.35*sin(t/4 - 0.12))*5)*6)/6
blue = floor(max(0, 1 - abs(y - 0.5 - 0.35*sin(t/4 - 0.24))*5)*6)/6
rgb(max(red, gold), max(gold*0.8, blue*0.6), blue)
